Faculty and Student Awards
Associate Professor Nicholas Schmerr has received the 50 under 50 Award from the Geological Society of America (GSA), the Geological Association of Canada (GAC-AGC), and the Sociedad Geológica Mexicana (SGM) that honors mid-career geoscientists.
Graduate Student Kathryn Gansler has been selected as a recipient of the 2026 International Association for Geoscience Diversity (IAGD) Inclusive Geoscience Education and Research (IGER) Award. read more...
Distinguished University Professor Richard Walker has been elected as a Fellow of the Meteoritical Society. read more...
Undergraduate major Kamirah Billups received a CMNS Alumni Network Endowed Undergraduate Award to support her field camp work at Bowling Green State University in Ohio. read more...
Professor Sujay Kaushal has been selected as a fellow of the International Association of Geochemistry for his significant contributions to the field of geochemistry.
